FREE_TRIAL_FAQ_QUESTION: How does the free trial work?
FREE_TRIAL_FAQ_ANSWER: You get 30 days of full access to all YoGym features, with no limitations or commitment. No credit card is required. At the end, you can choose the plan that suits you or stop at no cost.
DESKTOP_CLOUD_DIFFERENCE_QUESTION: What is the difference between Desktop and Cloud?
DESKTOP_CLOUD_DIFFERENCE_ANSWER: Desktop is installed on your computer with a one-time payment and is ideal for small or new gyms. Cloud is available online with monthly or annual payment and includes automatic updates, multi-gym management and a mobile app for members.
MULTIPLE_GYMS_ONE_ACCOUNT_QUESTION: Can I manage several gyms with one account?
MULTIPLE_GYMS_ONE_ACCOUNT_ANSWER: Yes, with Cloud. You can manage unlimited gyms from one account, with separate statistics for each location and subscriptions valid across several gyms.
CONTINUOUS_UPDATES_QUESTION: Does YoGym keep adding features and updates?
CONTINUOUS_UPDATES_ANSWER: Yes. YoGym evolves continuously. Our team regularly adds features and improves both the desktop and web versions.
TRAINING_SUPPORT_ANSWER: Yes. We provide complete free training during installation, plus technical support seven days a week. The interface is designed to be intuitive and easy to learn.
RECOMMENDED_VERSION_QUESTION: Which YoGym version do you recommend, Desktop or Cloud?
RECOMMENDED_VERSION_ANSWER: For new and small gyms, we recommend starting with Desktop to limit fixed costs while using complete software. As your gym and membership grow, you can move to Cloud for more flexibility, remote access and connected locations without losing your data.
